rules.message: Certificate verification is disabled.

metadata.remediation: Enable certificate and hostname verification with an approved trust store.

rules.message: TLS certificate validation is disabled.

metadata.remediation: Remove rejectUnauthorized: false and configure trusted certificates.

rules.message: Certificate callback accepts every certificate.

metadata.remediation: Use platform certificate validation; do not return true for every certificate.

rules.message: A shell command is constructed with formatted input.

metadata.remediation: Pass a fixed executable and separate argument list with shell=False; verify input trust.

rules.message: An interpolated command is passed to a shell.

metadata.remediation: Use execFile or spawn with a fixed executable and a separate validated argument list.

rules.message: SQL command text contains interpolation or concatenation.

metadata.remediation: Use parameterized SQL and verify the origin of each input.

rules.message: SQL execution receives formatted command text.

metadata.remediation: Use driver parameters and keep SQL structure constant.

rules.message: Object deserialization requires a trusted input source.

metadata.remediation: Avoid pickle on untrusted input; use a constrained data format and schema validation.

rules.message: BinaryFormatter deserialization can instantiate unsafe objects.

metadata.remediation: Replace BinaryFormatter with constrained data serialization and verify trust boundaries.

rules.message: Request data is passed directly to eval.

metadata.remediation: Replace evaluation with explicit parsing and a constrained set of operations.

rules.message: DES encryption is obsolete.

metadata.remediation: Use an approved authenticated encryption scheme appropriate to the protocol.

rules.message: gets cannot bound the number of bytes read.

metadata.remediation: Use a bounded input operation and validate its return value.

rules.message: LDAP filter uses concatenation or interpolation; input trust and escaping require review.

metadata.remediation: Use context-appropriate LDAP filter escaping and validate the input source.

rules.message: SQL connection string is interpolated; connection-string injection requires input-control evidence.

metadata.remediation: Use a connection-string builder with controlled properties; validate untrusted values.

rules.message: XML schema validation is explicitly disabled; review the input boundary and validation elsewhere.

metadata.remediation: Validate untrusted XML against an appropriate schema before relying on its structure.

rules.message: Detailed exception faults are enabled; check whether sensitive details reach unauthorized callers.

metadata.remediation: Disable detailed faults outside development and return controlled error responses.

rules.message: A literal password is assigned to a network credential; verify whether it is a real credential.

metadata.remediation: Obtain credentials from an approved secret source and exclude test-only fixtures from production findings.

rules.message: A request query value directly supplies an HTTP destination.

metadata.remediation: Constrain outbound destinations and redirects; inspect endpoint authorization and network controls.

rules.message: A request query value selects a type for instantiation.

metadata.remediation: Use a fixed allowlist of trusted types; do not allow callers to select arbitrary class names.

rules.message: Browser storage receives a value under a sensitive credential key; review data sensitivity and access.

metadata.remediation: Avoid persistent script-readable storage of sensitive credentials; use an appropriate protected session mechanism.

rules.message: URL-controlled input is inserted directly as HTML.

metadata.remediation: Use textContent or appropriate HTML sanitization; review browser decoding and reachability.

rules.message: strcpy does not receive the destination capacity; verify bounds before treating this as an overflow.

metadata.remediation: Use a checked copy with explicit capacity and verify size calculations and termination.
